name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Houthis Threaten to Expand Red Sea Attacks, and Claim Strike on Saudi Tanker
changes.summary: Saudi Arabia has not commented on the claim by the Houthis, who are backed by Iran and have vowed to close “all access routes” to Saudi oil shipments.

changes.title: S&P 500 Hits Record High as Stock Market Worries About Iran and AI Ease
changes.summary: The S&P 500 rose 1.8 percent, pushing past its previous peak at the start of June and capping a big turnaround from a recent sell off in technology stocks.

changes.title: An Angry Trump Struggles to Understand Iran’s Defiant Leaders
changes.summary: Iran’s leaders have perplexed several American presidents, perhaps none more than President Trump.

changes.title: Sailors Working in Strait of Hormuz Are Caught in Crossfire of Iran War
changes.summary: Thousands of civilian workers remain stranded on ships at risk of attack by Iran. On one vessel, sailors have been held by the Iranian navy for more than three months.

changes.title: Stocks Open at Record High as Oil Falls on Hopes of Iran Deal
changes.summary: The price of Brent crude oil fell sharply.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: The Senate is just days away from taking its month-long August recess, but Congress is also rapidly running out of time to avoid a government shutdown this fall and handle a host of other items. Lawmakers are scrambling to take action on everything from funding the Iran war to regulating cryptocurrency. Lisa Desjardins.

changes.title: Oil Giant Saudi Aramco Reports 33% Profit Surge, Despite Iran War Disruptions
changes.summary: Higher oil prices propelled a quarterly earnings jump for Saudi Arabia’s energy giant, which used pipelines to work around disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: Dow soars 900 points on strong corporate profits, hopes of Iran deal
changes.summary: Stocks notched new record highs on Tuesday as oil prices dipped and companies reported healthy profits.

changes.title: How the War in Iran Is Complicating Trump’s Agenda at Home
changes.summary: As President Trump heads to the West Coast to talk to Americans about the economy, the war in Iran is driving up costs and polls show the already unpopular conflict is losing support.

changes.title: Strait of Hormuz Deal With Iran Possible Soon, Bessent Says
changes.summary: Qatar said that draft language of a deal was being circulated, while Secretary of State Marco Rubio expressed optimism about the talks but added that nothing was final yet.
